steps.npc: Hi there. Do you need anything? I can clean herbs for a fee of 200 coins per herb. I can clean all of your herbs at once, or I can do individual herbs if you show them to me.
I can also decant your potion vials to into different doses. That service is free so long as you have the empty vials needed. If not, it's just a few coins.
Hello again. Do you need anything?
I didn't find anything that I could clean.

steps.text: If the only grimy herbs in the player's inventory are grimy ardrigal, grimy rogue's purse, grimy sito foil, grimy snake weed or grimy volencia moss:

steps.npc: I didn't find anything that I could clean. Unfortunately I'm not very good at cleaning jungle herbs.
I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.

options.text: Why would I pay for you to clean herbs?

steps.player: Why would I pay for you to clean herbs?

steps.npc: Many of my customers wish to sell the herbs which they can't clean to other adventurers. They might hope for a better price by doing this.

options.text: Who's that kid outside your shop?

steps.player: Who's that kid outside your shop?

steps.npc: I do not know where he came from. He came to Nardah recently, and said his business might help my customers, so I let him have some space out there.
He seems very lost in the world, but I hope his work will be a success for him.
Now, would you like me to clean your herbs or combine your potions?
